payload.friendly_name: Deploys report what they installed so the rebaseline expects it
payload.purpose_context: felix-deployer decides which security-monitor baselines a deploy will change from the files changed in git, but drift comes from what was installed on the host. A deploy that re-installs files committed earlier ends in a false 'unexpected drift' alert unless its author remembered to declare it, and two of 32 deploys did not. The deploy library will report the repo files it installed, and the deployer will map them to baselines automatically. Tracks kentonium3/kg-automation#1072.
payload.purpose_tldr: Stop false 'unexpected drift' security alerts after intended deploys by having deploys report the files they actually installed, so the security rebaseline expects exactly that drift.

payload.question: Which enforcement approach should #1072 build: runtime report from the deploy library, a declared installs: field, a CI lint, or runtime report plus declared fallback?

payload.final_answer: Runtime report. Kent, 2026-10-15 (AskUserQuestion, asked while formalizing #1072): the deploy library reports the repo files it installed; felix-deployer maps them via audited-surfaces.json to baselines and folds them in. Rejected: declared installs: field, CI lint only, runtime+declared fallback.

payload.question: Confirm the Intent Summary for #1072 (runtime installed-file report)

payload.final_answer: Confirmed (Kent, 2026-10-15): drive the full mission without further check-ins unless something unexpected comes up.

payload.wp_title: apply provides, isolates and reads the report
Tick folds reported baselines with two named gates
rebaseline maps reports with proof of installation; fold freshness
